create_channel: create a gRPC Channel to connect to a target with options and credentials
build_unary_unary_call: build a UnaryUnaryMultiCallable to make a unary-unary RPC call on a channel
build_unary_stream_call: build a UnaryStreamMultiCallable to make a unary-stream RPC call on a channel
build_stream_unary_call: build a StreamUnaryMultiCallable to make a stream-unary RPC call on a channel
build_stream_stream_call: build a StreamStreamMultiCallable to make a stream-stream RPC call on a channel
